head: Serato DJ comes to iPhone and iPad with Spotify and Apple Music
dek: Serato DJ is now an app for iPhone and iPad: mix songs from Apple Music, Spotify, Beatport, SoundCloud and Tidal, and plug into more than 120 hardware setups. It was #62 in Music among free apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: Your saved playlists and liked songs from those services show up in the app. It's made by Serato Limited and is free with in-app purchases.
means: If you want to try DJing with music you already stream, you can start on your phone.
todo: Download Serato DJ and log in with your music service; check the in-app purchases.
